targets.rawSql: WITH scoped_snapshots AS (SELECT s.*, r.id AS scoped_reservable_id, r.type || ':' || r.vendor || ':' || r.vendor_id AS reservable_rid, r.vendor, jr.status AS run_status, jr.snapshot_count AS recorded_snapshot_count, jr.duration_ms, jr.error, jr.started_at AS run_started_at, jr.completed_at AS run_completed_at, j.status AS job_status, j.id AS job_id, w.id AS watch_id, w.poi_id, p.name AS poi_name FROM availability_snapshot s JOIN reservables r ON r.id = s.reservable_id LEFT JOIN availability_job_run jr ON jr.id = s.run_id LEFT JOIN availability_job j ON j.id = jr.job_id LEFT JOIN availability_watch w ON w.id = j.watch_id LEFT JOIN pois p ON p.id = w.poi_id WHERE s.observed_at >= now() - (${days_back:sqlstring} || ' days')::interval AND (${run_status:sqlstring} IN ('', 'all') OR jr.status = ${run_status:sqlstring}) AND (${job_status:sqlstring} IN ('', 'all') OR j.status = ${job_status:sqlstring}) AND (${poi_name_search:sqlstring} = '' OR p.name ILIKE '%' || ${poi_name_search:sqlstring} || '%' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM reservable_pois rp JOIN pois lp ON lp.id = rp.poi_id WHERE rp.reservable_id = r.id AND lp.name ILIKE '%' || ${poi_name_search:sqlstring} || '%')) AND (${vendor:sqlstring} IN ('', '__all') OR r.vendor IN (${vendor:sqlstring})) AND (${rid_search:sqlstring} = '' OR r.type || ':' || r.vendor || ':' || r.vendor_id ILIKE '%' || ${rid_search:sqlstring} || '%')), fetch_batches AS (SELECT coalesce('run:' || run_id::text, 'observed:' || observed_at::text) AS fetch_key, max(run_id) AS run_id, count(*) AS snapshots, count(DISTINCT reservable_id) AS reservables, count(DISTINCT target_date) AS target_dates, max(duration_ms) AS duration_ms, min(observed_at) AS first_observed_at, max(observed_at) AS last_observed_at FROM scoped_snapshots GROUP BY 1) SELECT count(*) AS fetch_batches, count(*) FILTER (WHERE run_id IS NULL) AS ad_hoc_batches, count(*) FILTER (WHERE run_id IS NOT NULL) AS job_run_batches, coalesce(sum(snapshots), 0) AS snapshot_rows, (SELECT count(DISTINCT reservable_id) FROM scoped_snapshots) AS reservables_seen, (SELECT count(DISTINCT target_date) FROM scoped_snapshots) AS target_dates_seen, percentile_disc(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY duration_ms) FILTER (WHERE duration_ms IS NOT NULL) AS p50_duration_ms, percentile_disc(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY duration_ms) FILTER (WHERE duration_ms IS NOT NULL) AS p95_duration_ms, max(last_observed_at) AS latest_observed_at FROM fetch_batches;

WITH scoped_snapshots AS (SELECT s.*, r.type || ':' || r.vendor || ':' || r.vendor_id AS reservable_rid, r.vendor, jr.status AS run_status, j.status AS job_status, w.poi_id, p.name AS poi_name FROM availability_snapshot s JOIN reservables r ON r.id = s.reservable_id LEFT JOIN availability_job_run jr ON jr.id = s.run_id LEFT JOIN availability_job j ON j.id = jr.job_id LEFT JOIN availability_watch w ON w.id = j.watch_id LEFT JOIN pois p ON p.id = w.poi_id WHERE s.observed_at >= now() - (${days_back:sqlstring} || ' days')::interval AND (${run_status:sqlstring} IN ('', 'all') OR jr.status = ${run_status:sqlstring}) AND (${job_status:sqlstring} IN ('', 'all') OR j.status = ${job_status:sqlstring}) AND (${poi_name_search:sqlstring} = '' OR p.name ILIKE '%' || ${poi_name_search:sqlstring} || '%' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM reservable_pois rp JOIN pois lp ON lp.id = rp.poi_id WHERE rp.reservable_id = r.id AND lp.name ILIKE '%' || ${poi_name_search:sqlstring} || '%')) AND (${vendor:sqlstring} IN ('', '__all') OR r.vendor IN (${vendor:sqlstring})) AND (${rid_search:sqlstring} = '' OR r.type || ':' || r.vendor || ':' || r.vendor_id ILIKE '%' || ${rid_search:sqlstring} || '%')), fetch_batches AS (SELECT coalesce('run:' || run_id::text, 'observed:' || observed_at::text) AS fetch_key, coalesce(max(run_status), 'ad_hoc') AS run_status, max(observed_at) AS observed_at FROM scoped_snapshots GROUP BY 1) SELECT date_trunc(${bucket:sqlstring}, observed_at) AS time, run_status AS metric, count(*)::double precision AS value FROM fetch_batches GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2;

WITH scoped_snapshots AS (SELECT s.*, r.type || ':' || r.vendor || ':' || r.vendor_id AS reservable_rid, r.vendor, jr.status AS run_status, jr.duration_ms, jr.started_at AS run_started_at, j.status AS job_status, w.poi_id, p.name AS poi_name FROM availability_snapshot s JOIN reservables r ON r.id = s.reservable_id LEFT JOIN availability_job_run jr ON jr.id = s.run_id LEFT JOIN availability_job j ON j.id = jr.job_id LEFT JOIN availability_watch w ON w.id = j.watch_id LEFT JOIN pois p ON p.id = w.poi_id WHERE s.observed_at >= now() - (${days_back:sqlstring} || ' days')::interval AND (${run_status:sqlstring} IN ('', 'all') OR jr.status = ${run_status:sqlstring}) AND (${job_status:sqlstring} IN ('', 'all') OR j.status = ${job_status:sqlstring}) AND (${poi_name_search:sqlstring} = '' OR p.name ILIKE '%' || ${poi_name_search:sqlstring} || '%' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM reservable_pois rp JOIN pois lp ON lp.id = rp.poi_id WHERE rp.reservable_id = r.id AND lp.name ILIKE '%' || ${poi_name_search:sqlstring} || '%')) AND (${vendor:sqlstring} IN ('', '__all') OR r.vendor IN (${vendor:sqlstring})) AND (${rid_search:sqlstring} = '' OR r.type || ':' || r.vendor || ':' || r.vendor_id ILIKE '%' || ${rid_search:sqlstring} || '%')), run_durations AS (SELECT run_id, max(run_started_at) AS run_started_at, max(duration_ms) AS duration_ms FROM scoped_snapshots WHERE run_id IS NOT NULL AND duration_ms IS NOT NULL GROUP BY run_id) SELECT date_trunc(${bucket:sqlstring}, run_started_at) AS time, 'avg_duration_ms' AS metric, avg(duration_ms)::double precision AS value FROM run_durations GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;

WITH scoped_snapshots AS (SELECT s.*, r.type || ':' || r.vendor || ':' || r.vendor_id AS reservable_rid, r.vendor, jr.status AS run_status, j.status AS job_status, w.poi_id, p.name AS poi_name FROM availability_snapshot s JOIN reservables r ON r.id = s.reservable_id LEFT JOIN availability_job_run jr ON jr.id = s.run_id LEFT JOIN availability_job j ON j.id = jr.job_id LEFT JOIN availability_watch w ON w.id = j.watch_id LEFT JOIN pois p ON p.id = w.poi_id WHERE s.observed_at >= now() - (${days_back:sqlstring} || ' days')::interval AND (${run_status:sqlstring} IN ('', 'all') OR jr.status = ${run_status:sqlstring}) AND (${job_status:sqlstring} IN ('', 'all') OR j.status = ${job_status:sqlstring}) AND (${poi_name_search:sqlstring} = '' OR p.name ILIKE '%' || ${poi_name_search:sqlstring} || '%' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM reservable_pois rp JOIN pois lp ON lp.id = rp.poi_id WHERE rp.reservable_id = r.id AND lp.name ILIKE '%' || ${poi_name_search:sqlstring} || '%')) AND (${vendor:sqlstring} IN ('', '__all') OR r.vendor IN (${vendor:sqlstring})) AND (${rid_search:sqlstring} = '' OR r.type || ':' || r.vendor || ':' || r.vendor_id ILIKE '%' || ${rid_search:sqlstring} || '%')) SELECT date_trunc(${bucket:sqlstring}, observed_at) AS time, 'snapshot_rows' AS metric, count(*)::double precision AS value FROM scoped_snapshots GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;

WITH scoped_snapshots AS (SELECT s.*, r.id AS scoped_reservable_id, r.type || ':' || r.vendor || ':' || r.vendor_id AS reservable_rid, r.vendor, jr.status AS run_status, jr.snapshot_count AS recorded_snapshot_count, jr.duration_ms, jr.error, jr.started_at AS run_started_at, jr.completed_at AS run_completed_at, j.status AS job_status, j.id AS job_id, w.id AS watch_id, w.poi_id, p.name AS poi_name FROM availability_snapshot s JOIN reservables r ON r.id = s.reservable_id LEFT JOIN availability_job_run jr ON jr.id = s.run_id LEFT JOIN availability_job j ON j.id = jr.job_id LEFT JOIN availability_watch w ON w.id = j.watch_id LEFT JOIN pois p ON p.id = w.poi_id WHERE s.observed_at >= now() - (${days_back:sqlstring} || ' days')::interval AND (${run_status:sqlstring} IN ('', 'all') OR jr.status = ${run_status:sqlstring}) AND (${job_status:sqlstring} IN ('', 'all') OR j.status = ${job_status:sqlstring}) AND (${poi_name_search:sqlstring} = '' OR p.name ILIKE '%' || ${poi_name_search:sqlstring} || '%' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM reservable_pois rp JOIN pois lp ON lp.id = rp.poi_id WHERE rp.reservable_id = r.id AND lp.name ILIKE '%' || ${poi_name_search:sqlstring} || '%')) AND (${vendor:sqlstring} IN ('', '__all') OR r.vendor IN (${vendor:sqlstring})) AND (${rid_search:sqlstring} = '' OR r.type || ':' || r.vendor || ':' || r.vendor_id ILIKE '%' || ${rid_search:sqlstring} || '%')), fetch_batches AS (SELECT coalesce('run:' || run_id::text, 'observed:' || observed_at::text) AS fetch_key, max(run_id) AS run_id, max(job_id) AS job_id, max(watch_id) AS watch_id, CASE WHEN max(run_id) IS NULL THEN 'ad_hoc_snapshot_batch' WHEN max(poi_id) IS NOT NULL THEN 'poi' ELSE 'reservable' END AS watch_scope, max(poi_id) AS poi_id, max(poi_name) AS poi_name, min(reservable_rid) AS direct_reservable_rid, coalesce(max(run_status), 'ad_hoc') AS run_status, max(job_status) AS job_status, max(recorded_snapshot_count) AS recorded_snapshot_count, count(*) AS actual_snapshot_rows, count(DISTINCT reservable_id) AS observed_reservables, min(target_date) AS first_target_date, max(target_date) AS last_target_date, min(observed_at) AS first_observed_at, max(observed_at) AS last_observed_at, max(duration_ms) AS duration_ms, max(error) AS error, min(coalesce(run_started_at, observed_at)) AS started_at, max(run_completed_at) AS completed_at FROM scoped_snapshots GROUP BY 1) SELECT run_id, job_id, watch_id, watch_scope, poi_id, poi_name, direct_reservable_rid, run_status, job_status, recorded_snapshot_count, actual_snapshot_rows, observed_reservables, first_target_date, last_target_date, first_observed_at, last_observed_at, duration_ms, error, started_at, completed_at FROM fetch_batches ORDER BY last_observed_at DESC, fetch_key DESC LIMIT 200;

WITH scoped_snapshots AS (SELECT s.*, r.type || ':' || r.vendor || ':' || r.vendor_id AS reservable_rid, r.vendor, jr.status AS run_status, jr.snapshot_count AS recorded_snapshot_count, jr.started_at AS run_started_at, jr.completed_at AS run_completed_at, j.status AS job_status, j.id AS job_id, w.id AS watch_id, w.poi_id, p.name AS poi_name FROM availability_snapshot s JOIN reservables r ON r.id = s.reservable_id LEFT JOIN availability_job_run jr ON jr.id = s.run_id LEFT JOIN availability_job j ON j.id = jr.job_id LEFT JOIN availability_watch w ON w.id = j.watch_id LEFT JOIN pois p ON p.id = w.poi_id WHERE s.observed_at >= now() - (${days_back:sqlstring} || ' days')::interval AND (${run_status:sqlstring} IN ('', 'all') OR jr.status = ${run_status:sqlstring}) AND (${job_status:sqlstring} IN ('', 'all') OR j.status = ${job_status:sqlstring}) AND (${poi_name_search:sqlstring} = '' OR p.name ILIKE '%' || ${poi_name_search:sqlstring} || '%' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM reservable_pois rp JOIN pois lp ON lp.id = rp.poi_id WHERE rp.reservable_id = r.id AND lp.name ILIKE '%' || ${poi_name_search:sqlstring} || '%')) AND (${vendor:sqlstring} IN ('', '__all') OR r.vendor IN (${vendor:sqlstring})) AND (${rid_search:sqlstring} = '' OR r.type || ':' || r.vendor || ':' || r.vendor_id ILIKE '%' || ${rid_search:sqlstring} || '%')), fetch_batches AS (SELECT coalesce('run:' || run_id::text, 'observed:' || observed_at::text) AS fetch_key, max(run_id) AS run_id, max(job_id) AS job_id, coalesce(max(run_status), 'ad_hoc') AS run_status, max(recorded_snapshot_count) AS recorded_snapshot_count, count(*) AS actual_snapshot_rows, min(target_date) AS first_target_date, max(target_date) AS last_target_date, min(observed_at) AS first_observed_at, max(observed_at) AS last_observed_at, min(coalesce(run_started_at, observed_at)) AS started_at, max(run_completed_at) AS completed_at FROM scoped_snapshots GROUP BY 1) SELECT run_id, job_id, run_status, recorded_snapshot_count, actual_snapshot_rows, CASE WHEN run_id IS NULL OR recorded_snapshot_count IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE actual_snapshot_rows - recorded_snapshot_count END AS snapshot_delta, CASE WHEN run_id IS NULL OR recorded_snapshot_count IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE actual_snapshot_rows = recorded_snapshot_count END AS recorded_matches_actual, first_target_date, last_target_date, first_observed_at, last_observed_at, started_at, completed_at FROM fetch_batches ORDER BY last_observed_at DESC, fetch_key DESC LIMIT 200;

WITH scoped_snapshots AS (SELECT s.*, r.id AS scoped_reservable_id, r.type || ':' || r.vendor || ':' || r.vendor_id AS reservable_rid, r.vendor, r.source, r.name, r.loop, r.site_type, jr.status AS run_status, jr.started_at AS fetch_started_at, jr.duration_ms FROM availability_snapshot s JOIN reservables r ON r.id = s.reservable_id LEFT JOIN availability_job_run jr ON jr.id = s.run_id WHERE s.observed_at >= now() - (${days_back:sqlstring} || ' days')::interval AND (${run_status:sqlstring} IN ('', 'all') OR jr.status = ${run_status:sqlstring}) AND (${vendor:sqlstring} IN ('', '__all') OR r.vendor IN (${vendor:sqlstring})) AND (${rid_search:sqlstring} = '' OR r.type || ':' || r.vendor || ':' || r.vendor_id ILIKE '%' || ${rid_search:sqlstring} || '%')) SELECT scoped_reservable_id AS reservable_id, reservable_rid, vendor, source, name, loop, site_type, count(DISTINCT run_id) FILTER (WHERE run_id IS NOT NULL) AS fetch_runs, count(*) AS snapshot_rows, count(DISTINCT target_date) AS target_dates, max(observed_at) AS latest_observed_at, now() - max(observed_at) AS latest_observation_age, max(fetch_started_at) AS latest_fetch_started_at, count(*) FILTER (WHERE status::text = 'available' OR available) AS available_snapshots, count(*) FILTER (WHERE status::text IN ('reserved', 'booked')) AS reserved_snapshots, count(*) FILTER (WHERE status::text = 'closed') AS closed_snapshots FROM scoped_snapshots GROUP BY scoped_reservable_id, reservable_rid, vendor, source, name, loop, site_type ORDER BY latest_observed_at DESC, snapshot_rows DESC LIMIT 500;

SELECT s.id AS snapshot_id, s.run_id, jr.status AS run_status, r.type || ':' || r.vendor || ':' || r.vendor_id AS reservable_rid, r.name, r.vendor, r.source, s.observed_at, s.target_date, s.status AS observed_status, s.available, jsonb_pretty(s.day_payload) AS day_payload FROM availability_snapshot s JOIN reservables r ON r.id = s.reservable_id LEFT JOIN availability_job_run jr ON jr.id = s.run_id WHERE s.observed_at >= now() - (${days_back:sqlstring} || ' days')::interval AND (${run_status:sqlstring} IN ('', 'all') OR jr.status = ${run_status:sqlstring}) AND (${vendor:sqlstring} IN ('', '__all') OR r.vendor IN (${vendor:sqlstring})) AND (${rid_search:sqlstring} = '' OR r.type || ':' || r.vendor || ':' || r.vendor_id ILIKE '%' || ${rid_search:sqlstring} || '%') ORDER BY s.observed_at DESC, s.id DESC LIMIT 200;

SELECT namespace, count(*) AS cache_rows, count(*) FILTER (WHERE expires_at <= now()) AS expired_rows, min(created_at) AS oldest_created_at, max(created_at) AS newest_created_at, now() - max(created_at) AS newest_age, min(expires_at) AS earliest_expires_at, max(expires_at) AS latest_expires_at, min(expires_at) - now() AS shortest_freshness_remaining, pg_size_pretty(sum(payload_bytes)::bigint) AS payload_size FROM grafana_api_cache_metadata WHERE namespace IN ('recgov_availability', 'aspira_availability', 'aspira_occupancy') AND (${cache_key_search:sqlstring} = '' OR cache_key ILIKE '%' || ${cache_key_search:sqlstring} || '%') AND (${rid_search:sqlstring} = '' OR cache_key ILIKE '%' || split_part(${rid_search:sqlstring}, ':', 3) || '%') GROUP BY namespace ORDER BY namespace ASC;

list.name: vendor
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT vendor AS __text, vendor AS __value FROM reservables WHERE deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY vendor ASC
